items.title: GLAMhack 2026 - Apertus and Public AI Switzerland
items.summary: The 11th edition of our yearly Swiss Open Cultural Data Hackathon (or GLAMhack for short) was hosted by the Stiftung für Kunst, Kultur und Geschichte (SKKG) in Winterthur. This year’s theme is “Hack the Gap – Bridging Analog and Digital Worlds“For full details, visit https://opendata.ch/events/glamhack2026/Hackathon results: https://glamhack.vercel.app/
